<div class="card-body">
'''Restraining Bolt''' is a [[Light]] [[Device]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">行動規制ボルト</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">任意の位置カード上の好きなドロイドに配備する。そのドロイドは移動できず、カードルールを使用できない。同じ位置に別のドロイドがいれば、自分の支配フェイズに行動規制ボルトを（コストなしで）そのドロイドへ移動できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-38o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ドロイドの行動を制限し、命令に従わせるためのボルト。体表に露出する専用ソケットに接着する。“コーラー”による遠隔操作が可能。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Restraining Bolt.

'''Card text:''' Deploy on any droid at any location. That droid cannot move or use its game text. During your control phase, you may move the restraining bolt to another droid at the same location at no cost.

'''Lore:''' A bolt that limits a droid's actions and makes it obey orders. It attaches to a dedicated socket exposed on the droid's body. A caller can control it remotely.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Restraining Bolt]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
